summary: Static/readiness-only topology contract for future split deployment and remote Postgres work. Current single-host compose/local defaults remain authoritative and no runtime deployment behavior is enabled by this story.

current_default_preservation.required_statement: Current single-host/local compose defaults remain the only supported runtime topology for Story 132.1.

placement_rules: Only one registry_state writer placement may own mutable state at a time.
clawhip_daemon placement must be explicit before any split profile can activate.
worker_wrapper and orchestrator_adapter placement must preserve task idempotency and lock ownership.
telegram_gateway ingress placement must not bypass registry_api authorization boundaries.

required_boundaries: internal service-to-service traffic stays on an explicitly named private network
database traffic is restricted to approved application writers/readers
clawhip_daemon network reachability is explicit and least-privilege
external host commands are not introduced by this story

authority_rules: remote Postgres is a future data authority only after a later approved activation story
current local database defaults remain authoritative for runtime behavior
schema migrations require single-writer ownership and backup evidence before remote execution
event-log append authority must stay append-only and auditable across topology changes
data_boundary_coverage: read replica or analytics authority remains unsupported until separately approved

pooling: connection pool ownership and max-connection budget per service
migration: schema compatibility window for every service placement
backup: remote backup schedule and restore drill evidence
fallback to current single-host default documented before activation

requirements: public ingress routes only to approved edge services
registry_api remains the control boundary for production operations
dashboard or command-surface activation is not added by this story
no real secret values in contract docs tests or status artifacts
remote database credentials must come from a future approved secret store contract
connection strings with embedded passwords are forbidden in repository files
Story 131.2 credential readiness remains the production credential boundary

entries: remote Postgres without backup and restore evidence
read/write split without explicit consistency semantics
ad hoc external host networking commands

requirements: fallback to current single-host/local default remains documented
rollback identifies previous image and configuration references
remote database rollback requires backup restore or fix-forward evidence
split topology activation must be reversible before any production use

db_mtls_deferment.required_statement: Database mTLS design and activation are deferred to Epic 133 and are not implemented by Story 132.1.

core_invariants.single_writer_state_mutation: Exactly one state mutation writer may be authoritative before any future split profile can activate.
core_invariants.append_only_event_log_authority: Event-log authority remains append-only; topology changes must not rewrite or fork event history.
core_invariants.idempotency_and_locking: Task idempotency keys and distributed lock ownership must be preserved across service placement and database boundaries.
core_invariants.capability_tiers: Capability tiers and production-operation approvals remain enforced before split topology commands or writes can exist.

forbidden_runtime_expansion_surfaces: compose profile or compose overlay activation
environment activation flag for split deployment or remote Postgres
new deploy target for split deployment or remote Postgres
service route activation for topology or database switching
remote Postgres connection code or DSN defaults
external host or network command surface
fail_closed_checks: DB mTLS is deferred to Epic 133
no live split deployment or remote Postgres support is claimed
no runtime/deployment expansion surface is added by Story 132.1
mandatory justfile and CI checker wiring is present
non_goals: no docker compose profile or overlay activation
no deployment target or external host command
no migration runner or database migration execution
no service route or command surface activation
no DB mTLS implementation before Epic 133
